summary: Analysis of candidates identified a group of strong dual-role features (confounders and effect modifiers), including osteoarthritis presence, organomegaly, and optic chiasm enhancement. NYHA class and occupation also demonstrate dual roles. Optic nerve enhancement is identified primarily as an effect modifier. Several features (NSCLC diagnosis, orbital fat appearance, oncology management status) showed insufficient or inconsistent evidence to justify role assignment.
